label: Bible Study
prompt: For the _____ of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verse: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
note: Sin pays wages; God gives a gift — the contrast is the whole gospel.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: O _____ and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verse: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
note: David invites a taste test — the LORD's goodness holds up under sampling.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many _____.
verse: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
note: The KJV spells it 'colours' — the coat that launched a musical and a family feud.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Seek ye the LORD, all ye _____ of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD'S anger.
verse: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD'S anger.
note: Zephaniah's survival advice for the day of the LORD: seek meekness, not higher ground.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To an inheritance _____, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
verse: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
note: An inheritance 'incorruptible' — Peter's triple-negative treasure: cannot rot, stain, or fade.
